ns2:section.sectionText: This section has seats open for "pre-media" freshman and sophomores in the Division of General Studies. There are a limited number of seats available for each class level. If you receive the "RESERVED CLOSED" message that means that the seats for your class level are full and you will not be able to register for the course. For further assistance, please contact the College of Media course scheduler, Michele Andrews at mldrews@illinois.edu or 244-1810.
